_comment: Recorded execution results. A row in availability.md may only claim 'available, tested' when its
evidence key resolves here to at least one recorded run. SANDBOX-DOCS-0001 / F-D2: the generator
previously hard-coded that status, so it could assert a test nobody had run.
Each entry names the workflow run, the job, its conclusion, and the file in the review package

runs.what_it_exercised: the full suite with the container E2E flags set, Docker verified at the pinned 28.0.4, the sandbox image pulled by digest, and a real MCP server started in a container

the installed wheel, not the source tree: a real container running as uid 1000 on a read-only root filesystem, the hardening flags on the argv, and the production MCP pre-install path building a sealed volume and completing an initialize handshake

with no container runtime installed, run_tool on a trusted pack returned success=False, mode_used=sandbox_unavailable, with a plain-language reason. The refusal path only — nothing on this machine has ever started a sandbox.
